dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You stop at the top of the bookshelf on one side...

dialogues.speaker: Quiauhquetzal
dialogues.text: It's safe here. What is it, my golden friend?

choices.text: Nothing. I'm just a little curious, that's all...

response.speaker: Quiauhquetzal
response.text: Here, it's high up, and you can see far and wide. It's a good place to hide.

response.speaker: Quiauhquetzal
response.text: In our Cal{RUBY#[D]Tribe}pul, being on the ground is considered dangerous. Even if the Great {RUBY#[S]Sovereign Lords} Rulers above us don't decide to wipe us out on a whim, the other Calp{RUBY#[D]Tribes}ulli will still come to plunder us.

response.speaker: Quiauhquetzal
response.text: Perching on the cliffs and in the trees like the quetzals allows us to flee calamity before it strikes.

response.speaker: Quiauhquetzal
response.text: Besides, Vindia says that she wishes to see me fly. She wants to si{RUBY#[D]write}ng of riding a giant bird in a story of adventure.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you sure she isn't putting you on...?

response.speaker: Quiauhquetzal
response.text: No, no. Vindia is a very good person, maybe even as good as the Lord of the Crossroads. They're both such kind people.

response.speaker: Quiauhquetzal
response.text: But it's amazing just how you two flew, all the way up there.

response.speaker: Quiauhquetzal
response.text: This is for you. Consider it proof of our friendship. Now, I must think about how we can fly even higher to stay out of danger's reach.

response.speaker: Quiauhquetzal
response.text: Neither the Great {RUBY#[S]Sovereign Lords} Rulers nor the conquerors who revel in flaying are here, it is true... but I'm already used to having a means of escape wherever I am.

choices.text: I'm just wondering if you're stuck up there...

response.speaker: Quiauhquetzal
response.text: Thank you, but no, I'm not stuck. It's safe when I'm high up. Here, I won't get killed.
